purpose: Independent label-blind 20-notice confirmation cohort for prompt-only candidates. It is not a substitute for dev-200 confirmation.
selection_contract: Starts from dev records not included in dev_fast_panel_v1.

Records were sorted by total organizer-document character length into four equal-size remaining-data quartiles; five records were selected per quartile by the ascending SHA-256 digest of `prompt-holdout-v1:<id>`.
No dev label, evidence, historical prediction, item error, or experimental outcome was used in selection.
The ordered IDs are frozen before the EXP128 provider calls. The cohort has 11 national-contract and 9 local-contract notices.
